name: spreadsheets
description: Create, edit, analyze, visualize, render, verify, and export editable Microsoft Excel XLSX workbook files in Anybox.

shortDescription.zh-CN: 制作可编辑的 Office Excel XLSX 电子表格

longDescription.en-US: Create, edit, inspect, analyze, visualize, render, verify, and export editable Microsoft Excel XLSX workbooks plus CSV and TSV spreadsheets locally. Use Excel Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is an Office Excel workbook, XLSX file, spreadsheet, sheet, or CSV file.
longDescription.zh-CN: 在本地制作、编辑、分析、可视化、检查、渲染、验证并导出可在 Microsoft Office Excel 中继续编辑的 XLSX/Excel 工作簿，以及 CSV 和 TSV 电子表格。当目标产物是 Office Excel 工作簿、XLSX 文件、电子表格、表格或 CSV 文件时使用。

skillPreviews.name: Excel XLSX Builder
skillPreviews.description: Use this skill when a user requests to create, modify, analyze, visualize, or work with editable Microsoft Excel spreadsheet files (`.xlsx`, `.xls`, `.csv`, `.tsv`) with formulas, formatting, charts, tables, and recalculation.
